correctness.rationale: Verified the right-operation convention and both directions of the reduction in RESULT.md:34–45. The right shift fixes the distinguished index and permutes the identity translations, which gives self-distributivity. Equating the distinguished point to an integer identifies i with i+1 for every i, forcing the universal relation. Otherwise forward compatibility is exactly preservation under successor. For a direct exhaustion check, let I be the set of i sharing their class with some later j. I is upward closed; at any index i in I its first positive return d gives d distinct classes on that cycle (a duplicate within it would shift forward to an earlier return at i). All later classes stay on that cycle, and cycles starting at different indices of I coincide by looking far enough forward. If I is empty there is equality; if I is all of Z the relation is P_d; otherwise I is [c,∞)∩Z, and no pair whose smaller index is below c is identified, giving H_{c,d}. This proves uniqueness and exhaustion without enumeration. Backward shift respects P_d and fails for (c,c+d) in H_{c,d}. The inclusion criterion follows by testing the first admitted cutoff and divisibility of gaps, with P_d the infinite-left extension; the resulting product order gives the stated max/lcm meet and min/gcd join and distributivity even after adjoining bottom and top. Forward translates and their equivalence closure generate H_{c,d} from the one pair; every finite set of P_d pairs lies in some H_{c,d}, so cannot generate P_d in the forward signature. Its quotients are finite, whereas a finite cutoff leaves infinitely many singleton classes; the universal quotient is also finite and genuine. Read check.py and VERIFICATION.md; the 1,640 reported bounded cases were not rerun and do not certify the classification. The proof uses one bi-infinite shift orbit and only the forward operation for generation.

value.rationale: The smallest canonical shift example supplies a complete, usable lattice of one-operation obstructions, rather than one witness of inverse failure. Cutoff and period give independent order coordinates, and the nontrivial proper compact elements are precisely the nongenuine ones even though every finite quotient is genuine. That exact benchmark is useful for studying more complicated rack quotients and is not claimed to classify multiple-orbit actions.
